title: Kids’ Club PJ Party
seo_title: Kids’ Club PJ Party at Fun Mountain, Dec 4
description: Kids’ Club PJ Party is a Christmas-themed evening where kids join Santa’s elves for holiday adventure, while parents can enjoy a night out at one of the award-winning dining locations. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM at the Kids’ Nature Discovery Center at Fun Mountain.
venue: Kids’ Nature Discovery Center at Fun Mountain
